extracted_text.text: 育児・産休・介護休業規程制定日：2024年4月1日　改訂日：2025年10月1日　人事部第1条（目的）本規程は、育児・介護休業法に基づき、従業員が育児または家族の介護を行うために休業を取得できる制度を定めることを目的とする。第2条（産前産後休業）産前：出産予定日の8週間前（多胎妊娠の場合は14週間前）から取得可能。産後：出産日の翌日から8週間（本人の希望があり医師が認めた場合は6週間後から就業可）。第3条（育児休業）対象：1歳未満の子を養育する従業員（パパ育休制度により父親も取得可）。期間：原則として子が1歳になるまで。保育所入所待機等の場合は最長2歳まで延長可。分割取得：2回まで分割取得が可能（2022年10月改正育介法対応）。第4条（申請手続き）・休業開始予定日の1ヶ月前（産後パパ育休は2週間前）までに「育児休業取得申請書」を人事部へ提出。・休業期間中の社会保険料免除手続きは人事部が代行する。・給付金（育児休業給付金）は従業員本人がハローワークへ申請すること。第5条（介護休業）対象：要介護状態にある家族を介護する従業員。期間：同一対象家族につき通算93日（3回まで分割可）。介護休暇：年5日（対象家族が2人以上の場合は年10日）。第6条（子の看護休暇）小学校就学前の子1人につき年5日、2人以上は年10日。1時間単位での取得が可能（時間単位取得：2021年1月施行）。第7条（社会保険・給付）育児休業中は健康保険・厚生年金の保険料が免除される（免除期間も被保険者期間に算入）。雇用保険から育児休業給付金が支給される（休業開始時賃金の67%、181日以降は50%）。承認フロー1. 従業員 → 申請書提出 → 人事部受付2. 人事部 → 上長確認 → 承認3. 人事部 → 社会保険事務所への届出4. 人事部 → 従業員へ承認通知（システム登録）以上　本規程に関するお問い合わせは人事部（内線：3001）まで。

# Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |

Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |

Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。

# Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。

Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。

Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。

# Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。

target_field.value: # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。

target_field.value: # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。

Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。

Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。

# Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。

target_field.value: # Theme M1 — Local Setup GuideMixed multi-domain orchestrator (HR + Finance + Ops portals).  Produces aligned GT logs for UIA AutoSeg V2 evaluation.---## Prerequisites| Requirement | Notes ||---|---|| Python 3.11+ | Must be on PATH or at a standard install location || Google Chrome | Standard install at `C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\` || ProcMine Desktop Agent | Must be running and recording before you start a session || ProcMine Browser Extension | Unpacked extension folder (one-time Chrome setup below) || Microsoft Excel | Optional — lookup steps are skipped if absent |> Teams, Outlook, and OneNote are **not required**. The orchestrator skips those noise steps automatically if the apps are not present.---## 1. Clone and install dependencies```powershellgit clone https://github.com/I-mBesideYou/procmine-test-sets.gitcd procmine-test-sets/Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automationpip install pyautogui websocket-client```---## 2. One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。

One-time browser extension setupThe ProcMine browser extension captures browser navigation, clicks, and form inputs (L3 events). It must be loaded into each of the three Chrome portal windows once. After that it persists in the Chrome profiles stored at `theme_m1_data/chrome-profiles/` and loads automatically on every future run.**Step 1 — Get the extension**Download `procmine-extension-v1.0.0.zip` from the team drive and unzip it. Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。
