Note the path to the unpacked folder (e.g. `C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension\`).**Step 2 — Run the one-time setup script**```powershellcd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation$chrome = "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe"$base   = "$PSScriptRoot\..\..\chrome-profiles"   # created automatically$ext    = "C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\procmine-extension"  # your path# Kill any existing Chrome, then open one window per portaltaskkill /F /IM chrome.exe 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2foreach ($entry in @(    @{dir="m1-hr";      url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"},    @{dir="m1-finance"; url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"},    @{dir="m1-ops";     url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"})) {    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\$($entry.dir)" | Out-Null    Start-Process $chrome -ArgumentList "--user-data-dir=`"$base\$($entry.dir)`"","--no-first-run","--new-window",$entry.url    Start-Sleep 3}```> The portals won't load (no http.server running yet) — that's fine. You just need Chrome open with each profile.**Step 3 — Load the extension in each window**In each of the 3 Chrome windows:1. Open a new tab → navigate to `chrome://extensions`2. Enable **Developer mode** (toggle, top-right)3. Click **Load unpacked** → select the `procmine-extension` folder4. Confirm extension ID `gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn` appears5. Close the extensions tab**Step 4 — Close all Chrome windows**The extension is now saved to each profile. You're done — don't repeat this unless you delete `chrome-profiles/`.---## 3. Running a session**Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent first** and confirm it is recording.Then run either launcher:```powershell# PowerShell launcher (interactive prompts)cd Mixed/theme_m1_data/process_automation.\launch_m1.ps1# Or Python launcher (same behaviour, cross-platform args)python scripts/run_theme_m1.pypython scripts/run_theme_m1.py --seed 42 --speed 1 --scale 2```### Run parameters| Prompt / Flag | Values | Default ||---|---|---|| Seed | Any integer | Random || Speed | `1` = fast (0.4×) · `2` = normal (1.4×) | `2` || Scale | `1` = 5–7 procs · `2` = 8–10 · `3` = 11–14 | `2` || Date | `YYYY-MM-DD` | Today |Pre-set with env vars to skip prompts:```powershell$env:M1_SEED = "42"; $env:M1_SPEED = "1"; $env:M1_SCALE = "2".\launch_m1.ps1```### What launches- 3 Python `http.server` instances (ports 5122 / 5123 / 5124)- Notepad- Excel with `documents/m1_reference.xlsx` (if available)- 3 Chrome windows (HR / Finance / Ops portals), each with CDP and ProcMine extension### Extension checkThe launcher prints one of:```[OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured``````[warn] Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: ...```If you see the warn, do the one-time extension setup (section 2) before continuing.---## 4. OutputAfter the run, GT logs land in:```Mixed/theme_m1_data/gt-logs/  theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl```Raw chunk arrives in S3 a few minutes after the session ends (desktop agent uploads asynchronously).---## 5. Per-chunk delivery packageOnce the chunk is in S3, generate the delivery package manually:```bashpython scripts/gen_chunk_package.py \  --gt    gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --out   gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_package \  --events   /path/to/downloaded/events.jsonl \  --manifest /path/to/downloaded/manifest.json \  --s3-prefix s3://procmine-app/chunks/<uid>/<chunk_id>/```Then run the official self-check:```bashpython C:\Users\<you>\Downloads\uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py \  --events-jsonl /path/to/events.jsonl \  --manifest     /path/to/manifest.json \  --gt-jsonl     gt-logs/theme_m1_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.jsonl \  --no-run-pipeline --summary-only --pretty```Minimum pass criteria (from handoff doc section 4.4):```guardrails.status = pass (or warn)guardrails.failures = []manifest_event_line_count == actual event_count: OKGT/raw timestamp overlap: high (≥ 90%)```---## 6. Folder layout after setup```Mixed/theme_m1_data/  process_automation/       <- launchers and scripts    launch_m1.ps1    scripts/      orchestrator_m1.py      run_theme_m1.py      gen_chunk_package.py      uia_autoseg_chunk_report.py    tools/      hr-portal-jp/      finance-portal-jp/      ops-portal-jp/    documents/      m1_reference.xlsx  chrome-profiles/          <- gitignored; Chrome user-data-dirs with extension    m1-hr/    m1-finance/    m1-ops/  gt-logs/                  <- gitignored; GT JSONL files and packages```---## 7. Troubleshooting| Symptom | Fix ||---|---|| `[warn] Extension not found` | Redo one-time extension setup (section 2). Check `chrome-profiles/m1-hr/Default/Secure Preferences` contains the extension ID. || `[warn] NMH not running` | Start the ProcMine Desktop Agent before launching. || `browser_navigation: 0` in chunk | Extension was loaded after portals were already open (content scripts didn't inject). Close Chrome, re-run — extension now loads at Chrome start. || Port 5122/5123/5124 already in use | Run `taskkill /F /IM python.exe` or restart. || `pyautogui` / `websocket` not found | `pip install pyautogui websocket-client` || GT log not found after run | Check `gt-logs/` in the theme_m1_data folder. Confirm the orchestrator didn't crash mid-run. |v介護休業申請を受理。期間: 2026-07-30 〜 2027-01-11。HW-2026-409と照合済。承認完了。----------------------------------------千葉金属工業へ PO-2026-469 に関する'数量変更依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------みずほ銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W3。未達取引 TXN-490 を照合。仕訳 JV-20-330 で消込完了。----------------------------------------横浜精機へ PO-2026-544 に関する'納期回答依頼'を送付。回答待ち。----------------------------------------三井住友銀行 勘定照合 2026-05-W4。未達取引 TXN-843 を照合。仕訳 JV-37-265 で消込完了。
